briefdescription.para: The user iterators for a memory access.
This iterator walks over all of the defs in a given MemoryAccess.

detaileddescription.para: For MemoryPhi nodes, this walks arguments. For MemoryUse/MemoryDef, this walks the defining access.

briefdescription.para: Get the iterators for the all access list and the defs only list We default to the all access list.
Used by MemorySSA to change the block of a MemoryAccess when it is moved.
Used for debugging and tracking things about MemoryAccesses.

detaileddescription.para: Guaranteed unique among MemoryAccesses, no guarantees otherwise.
